# SEO-577: Declare the canonical URL in the preview URL property

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

The Open Graph url property carries the same absolute canonical URL the page declares in its canonical link, so a share of any alias resolves to one address.

## Rationale

Preview caches are keyed by the address they were given, so a page shared through several aliases accumulates separate cached previews and separate share counts for what is one page.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Read the value from the same builder that produces the canonical link rather than from the incoming request address, so the two cannot diverge and neither reflects a tracking parameter.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Extract the Open Graph url property and the canonical link from the same response and confirm both are absolute and identical.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`, `RAW_HTML`
- Automated check: `og-url-matches-canonical`
